text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Phew! We worked super hard today too! I'm 
starving!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Tonight's radiance is truly 
magnificent once again...!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Hm? That voice—

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
I knew it was you, Ope-chan! Are you going 
out for dinner??

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
I'm heading out for a run! Along with that 
evening star up there!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Running with the first star of the 
evening... !?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Yes! By the radiance of the stars, I shall 
polish my beauty and these legs of mine!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Wah! I wanna do it too! It looks so cool, 
and like it'll make me strong!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Trainer!! Let's do it! I wanna get 
the strongest and take 1st place!
choice_data_list: Rest is important for strength, too.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Welcome! However... I won't yield the 
brightest shine to anyone!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Fufufufu~! That's my line!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"Bwahahaha! This looks to be an 
interesting run!"

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Wait, waaaait!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: *pant*... *wheeze*... W-Wait uuuup...!

Haru Urara gave it her absolute all during 
the extra training...!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Is that so...?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Heh... Precisely! Otherwise, a shadow 
would fall across my brilliance.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Speaking of which, I also relaxed in a 
rose bath yesterday!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
"Ooooh! I see, got it! I'll take a 
"re-cump" so I can get stronger!"

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: In a rose bath...?!

Having secured a promise to get some roses 
later, Haru Urara headed back to her room 
in high spirits...
